title: Seasick Disco Pluck
description: A bright triangle pluck bounces through a shifting euclid/ply grid, its pitch perpetually woozy from a deepening seasick vibrato while a penv click sharpens each hit. A rhythmic stereo delay smears the bounce into space, and the whole figure transposes through a slow four-chord arc.
code:
setcpm(128/4)
stack(
  note("<c3 eb3 g3 bb3>*4".add(note("<0 0 3 -2>/16")))
    .s("triangle")
    .attack(0.001)
    .decay(0.18)
    .sustain(0)
    .penv("<7 12 5 9>/8").pattack(0.001).pdecay(0.06)
    .vib("<3 5 7>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(23).range(0.6, 1.4))
    .euclidLegato("<5 7 5 3>/8", 8)
    .ply("<1 2 1 1>/4")
    .lpf(sine.slow(13).range(900, 4200)).resonance(8)
    .pan(sine.slow(11).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .delay("0.5:0.1875:0.62").delayfeedback(0.55)
    .shape(0.3)
    .gain(0.85)
)
